# T007.1 — Home MVC controller and view

## Summary

The independently runnable .NET 10 host now renders the Home MVC page at `/` and `/Home/Index`, without changing the legacy project or the existing Sample API route.

## Changes (files and why)

- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/Program.cs` — Enable controllers with views, conventional Home/Index routing, and static files alongside the existing attribute-routed Sample API.
- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/Controllers/HomeController.cs` — Port the original Index action and `Home Page` title.
- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/Views/_ViewStart.cshtml`, `Views/Home/Index.cshtml`, `Views/Shared/_Layout.cshtml` — Port the Home text, title, navbar and footer; replace System.Web bundle and action-link helpers with direct static references and navigation URLs.
- `DescopeSampleApp.Core/wwwroot/Content/bootstrap.min.css`, `Site.css`, `wwwroot/Scripts/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` — Copy existing Bootstrap/Site assets into the new host; use Bootstrap's existing bundle for the navbar without copying the vulnerable legacy jQuery or unused Modernizr.
- `DescopeSampleApp.IntegrationTests/HomeMvcTests.cs` — WebApplicationFactory assertions for both Home URLs, HTML/title/navbar/link intent, serving static assets, and continued `/api/sample` 401 behavior.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

- Keep side-by-side routing with no YARP or legacy modifications (approved plan T007). ASP.NET Core `AddControllersWithViews`, `UseStaticFiles` and `MapControllerRoute("{controller=Home}/{action=Index}/{id?}")` follow the [Microsoft conventional-routing guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/aspnet/core/mvc/controllers/routing?view=aspnetcore-10.0#set-up-conventional-route); retain `MapControllers` for the existing attribute-routed API.
- The navbar's Authenticated Page destination is `/AuthenticatedPage.aspx`, consistent with the source-level T002 link intent. That page is **not yet ported** (planned T010); this task tests navigation intent, not a successful target response.
- T002 characterized the Home controller's title and checked-in view text and the route declaration, **not hosted HTTP or rendered HTML**. The new-host title, exact rendered markup, asset URLs, link URLs, and HTTP status are new-host expectations, not verified byte-for-byte legacy output. Bundle minification, Modernizr/jQuery inclusion and generated legacy `ActionLink` URL details were not characterized. The migrated page deliberately does not copy the known-vulnerable jQuery.

## Validation (commands and results)

- `msbuild -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true -p:Configuration=Release -m -nologo -v:minimal` — pass; pre-existing NU1902 advisories and MSB3247 assembly conflict remain.
- `dotnet test --no-build -c Release` — pass; 63 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (23 net48 and 40 net10, up from 57 before this task).
- Lint — none defined.

## Follow-ups and risks

- `/AuthenticatedPage.aspx` remains an intended link until T010 implements it; no legacy HTTP capture confirms the exact generated link URL or served page headers. Verify the target and any browser-specific layout differences when page ports and browser tests are available.
- The existing legacy jQuery advisories and assembly conflict are outside this task's permitted scope. Static assets copied here are the existing Bootstrap and Site files, not an independently audited dependency upgrade.
